children.label: a
children.prompt: Measure the length of the fly in the illustration, correct to the nearest millimetre, then calculate its actual length.

answer.short: Illustration: approximately $94\text{ mm}$; actual fly: approximately $9.4\text{ mm}$.
answer.worked:
The scale $10:1$ means that $10\text{ mm}$ in the illustration represents $1\text{ mm}$ on the actual fly. Using an illustrated length of approximately $94\text{ mm}$:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Actual fly length}&=94\div10\\\text{Actual fly length}&\approx9.4\text{ mm}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Measure the length of the wing in the illustration, correct to the nearest millimetre, then calculate its approximate length.

answer.short: Illustration: approximately $63\text{ mm}$; actual wing: approximately $6.3\text{ mm}$.
answer.worked:
The scale $10:1$ means that illustrated lengths are ten times actual lengths. Using an illustrated wing length of approximately $63\text{ mm}$:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Actual wing length}&=63\div10\\\text{Actual wing length}&\approx6.3\text{ mm}.\end{align*}$$
